assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are suggestive of sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture arrhythmic events
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to guide further management
The procedure is medically necessary to document the intermittent arrhythmia that cannot be captured on a standard ECG
The procedure is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with rhythm
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
